model.note: Part outlines are traced from Toro's studio photo of the TransPro 80 (model 04235) and are approximate. The tie-down straps and wheel bearings are listed without outlines. No Toro manual was in the machinery file, so the checks are best practice, and Notion's TransPro part numbers are unconfirmed: check them against parts catalog 3479-338 and read the model and serial plate (04235 or another TransPro 80 version) before ordering.

wheelL.name: Wheel and tyre, left
wheelL.desc: Before use: tyre pressure, cuts and tread, wheel nuts tight. Every 3 months: re-torque the wheel nuts and check the tyre condition. Notion's 'run at 10 psi max' is unverified: use the tyre sidewall and the TransPro operator's manual.

wheelR.name: Wheel and tyre, right
wheelR.desc: Before use: tyre pressure, cuts and tread, wheel nuts tight. Every 3 months: re-torque the wheel nuts and check the tyre condition. Notion's 'run at 10 psi max' is unverified: use the tyre sidewall and the TransPro operator's manual.

frame.name: Main frame and axles
frame.desc: Annual: check the frame, tongue and coupling for cracks, corrosion and wear. Grease the coupling and any pivots every 3 months.

cradle.name: Mower cradle plate
cradle.desc: Carries the greens mower. Before moving: mower strapped down and the load secured. Annual: check the frame, tongue and coupling for cracks, corrosion and wear. Grease the coupling and any pivots every 3 months.

postL.name: Left upright and latch
postL.desc: Mower hold-down upright with latch. Make sure everything is stowed and latched before towing, and grease the pivots every 3 months.

postR.name: Right upright and latch
postR.desc: Mower hold-down upright with latch. Make sure everything is stowed and latched before towing, and grease the pivots every 3 months.

handle.name: Grip handle
handle.desc: Handle on the frame. Grease nearby pivots every 3 months.

tongue.name: Tongue
tongue.desc: Notion's 'max tongue load 25 kg' is unverified: check the TransPro operator's manual. Annual: check the frame, tongue and coupling for cracks, corrosion and wear. Grease the coupling and any pivots every 3 months.

latch.name: Tongue latch
latch.desc: Latch it before towing; grease the pivot every 3 months.

hitch.name: Tow eye and hitch pin
hitch.desc: Before each tow: coupling locked and pinned, and safety chain(s) connected if fitted. Grease the coupling every 3 months. Notion's hitch pin 110-0730, safety chain 110-0735 and hitch kit 107-8188 are unconfirmed: check them against parts catalog 3479-338 before ordering.

straps.name: Tie-down straps
straps.desc: Mower strapped down before every move. Notion's strap kit 110-0740 is unconfirmed: check it against parts catalog 3479-338.

notion.name: Notion part numbers (unconfirmed)
notion.desc: Notion lists strap kit 110-0740, jack stand 110-0745, hitch pin 110-0730, safety chain 110-0735, tyre pair 110-0722, bearing kit 110-0725, hitch kit 107-8188 and ramps 04245 / 04247. None could be confirmed: the 110-07xx numbers run in neat steps of 5, which suggests they were made up. Check every one against TransPro 80 parts catalog 3479-338 (Toro dealer) before ordering. taskTracker has no trailer PM template: add a 3-monthly check and an annual bearing and frame service.

hub.name: Hub and wheel bearings
hub.desc: Annual: check the bearings for play and noise; repack or replace and fit new seals yearly. Trailers that sit wet on the course get water in the bearings: check them yearly even at low km. Bearing kits go by hub make: read the hub stamping. Notion's bearing kit 110-0725 is unconfirmed.
